question: What among the following is the required profession of the applicant as on 3rd March 2022 in order to apply for the benefits of PM KUSUM Yojana?
solution:
The correct answer is **''Farmer''.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (KUSUM) **was launched by the Government of India in **March 2019**.
 
• The **objective **of this was to increase the income of farmers and provide irrigation to farmers.
 
• **Benefits of this scheme:**
 
 
• A 60% subsidy will be provided to the eligible farmers on the total cost of solar pumps and the remaining 30% of the cost will be provided into bank accounts.
 
• Farmers can sell the extra power to the government as this will increase their income.
 
• The use of solar power will also help in lowering pollution.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This scheme was announced by the **Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.**
 
• The eligible candidates for this scheme are a farmer or groups, farmer producer organizations, panchayat, etc.
 
• This scheme is implemented by different agencies in different states in Himachal Pradesh it is implemented by** HIMURJA.**
 
• This will also help the country in fulfilling its commitment to achieving the goal of increasing the share of installed capacity of electric power from non-fossil fuel sources to 20% by 2030.
 
• This scheme consists of **three components:** 
 
 
• Component A - 10,000 MW of solar capacity through the installation of small power plants of 2MW capacity.
 
• Component B - Installation of 20 lakhs Solar Power Agriculture Pumps.
 
• Component C - Solarisation of 15 lakhs grid-connected agriculture pumps.
